\section[veyil]{\ta{வெயில்} (veyil) — sunshine, the heat of the sun}

\label{lesson:TA-C91-sunshine}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for alone, then the Tamil for I am hungry.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{வெயில்}}
\textbf{\ta{வெயில்}} (\emph{veyil}) — \textquotedblleft{}sunshine\textquotedblright{}, the heat of the sun.

\textbf{\ta{வெயில்} \ta{அதிகம்}} — \textquotedblleft{}the sun is strong\textquotedblright{}, literally \textquotedblleft{}the sunshine is much\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
The sun's heat.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{veyil}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{veyil}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{veyil atikam}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for alone, then the Tamil for I am hungry, then say \emph{veyil} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{வெயில்} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Sunshine, the heat of the sun\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[cūṭu]{\ta{சூடு} (cūṭu) — heat; hot}

\label{lesson:TA-C91-heat}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for I am hungry, then the Tamil for sunshine.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{சூடு}}
\textbf{\ta{சூடு}} (\emph{cūṭu}) — \textquotedblleft{}heat\textquotedblright{}, and of a thing, \textquotedblleft{}hot\textquotedblright{}.

\textbf{\ta{சூடாக} \ta{இருக்கிறது}} — \textquotedblleft{}it is hot\textquotedblright{}. Tea, a pan, a forehead: anything can be \textbf{\ta{சூடு}}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Heat, of a day or a thing.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{cūṭu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{cūṭu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{cūṭāka irukkiṟatu}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for I am hungry, then the Tamil for sunshine, then say \emph{cūṭu} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{சூடு} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Heat; hot\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[tūkkam varukiṟatu]{\ta{தூக்கம்} \ta{வருகிறது} (tūkkam varukiṟatu) — (I) am sleepy}

\label{lesson:TA-C91-sleepy}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for sunshine, then the Tamil for heat.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{தூக்கம்} \ta{வருகிறது}}
\textbf{\ta{தூக்கம்} \ta{வருகிறது}} (\emph{tūkkam varukiṟatu}) — \textquotedblleft{}I am sleepy\textquotedblright{}, literally \textquotedblleft{}sleep is coming\textquotedblright{}.

\textbf{\ta{தூக்கம்}} is the sleep you know, on the coming frame of laughter and tears.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Sleep, which comes to you.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tūkkam varukiṟatu}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{tūkkam varukiṟatu}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{tūkkam varukiṟatu}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for sunshine, then the Tamil for heat, then say \emph{tūkkam varukiṟatu} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{தூக்கம்} \ta{வருகிறது} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}(I) am sleepy\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[naṉṟāka]{\ta{நன்றாக} (naṉṟāka) — well, fine}

\label{lesson:TA-C91-well}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Tamil for heat, then the Tamil for I am sleepy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ta{நன்றாக}}
\textbf{\ta{நன்றாக}} (\emph{naṉṟāka}) — \textquotedblleft{}well, fine\textquotedblright{}.

\textbf{\ta{நான்} \ta{நன்றாக} \ta{இருக்கிறேன்}} — \textquotedblleft{}I am well\textquotedblright{}, the everyday answer to how are you.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
Sun, heat, sleepy, and an answer for good days.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{naṉṟāka}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{naṉṟāka}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} say \emph{nāṉ naṉṟāka irukkiṟēṉ}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Tamil for heat, then the Tamil for I am sleepy, then say \emph{naṉṟāka} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ta{நன்றாக} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Well, fine\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
